problem.title: Valid Parentheses
problem.statement: Determine if a string of brackets is valid. Valid means: every opening bracket must be closed by the same type, and in the correct order. Valid example: ([{}]). Invalid example: ([)].
problem.hint: When you open a bracket {, the matching closing bracket must come AFTER all brackets inside it are closed first. What data structure is good for waiting?
problem.walkthrough:
Example string: ([{}]).

Read (: stack empty. Push (. Stack: [(]
Read [: match. Push [. Stack: [(,[]
Read {: match. Push {. Stack: [(,[,{]
Read }: matches { on top. Pop. Stack: [(,[]
Read ]: matches [ on top. Pop. Stack: [(]
Read ): matches ( on top. Pop. Stack: []

Done, stack is empty = valid!

Invalid example ([)]:
Read (: stack [(]
Read [: stack [(,[]
Read ): should match [, but found ). NOT VALID!

Key insight: the stack always holds opening brackets that are still waiting for their match.
